about.story_headline: The story behind our commitment to Andorra
story_paragraphs: We started with a clear vision: make buying, selling, or renting property in Andorra a transparent, personal process for residents and international buyers alike. What began as a small, passionate team has grown into a full-service real estate agency present in every parish of the country.

Year after year, our commitment to integrity, detail, and genuine relationships has let us guide hundreds of families and investors across Andorra la Vella, Escaldes-Engordany, and the rest of the country. We know the tax rules, the foreign investment process, and the character of every parish, so you don't have to figure it out alone.

contact.faq_headline: Quick answers before you reach out
contact.faq_subtitle: Got something on your mind? Check below — or just send us a message, we'll take it from there.

faq.q: Can I buy property in Andorra if I'm not a resident?
faq.a: Yes. Andorra allows non-residents to purchase property, but a foreign investment authorization must be requested from the Andorran Government before the sale is finalized. We guide you through this process so it stays smooth and surprise-free.

We work across the entire country: Andorra la Vella, Escaldes-Engordany, Encamp, La Massana, Ordino, Sant Julià de Lòria, and Canillo. We know the character of every parish so we can help you find the right fit.

faq.q: How long does the property buying process take?
faq.a: On average, 4 to 8 weeks once an offer is accepted, depending on financing and, where applicable, foreign investment authorization approval. We'll keep you informed at every step.
Yes — we work with both buyers and renters. Whether you're after a long-term lease or a seasonal second home, we'll help you find the right option.

faq.q: Can buying property help me get tax residency in Andorra?
faq.a: Buying property is often one step within Andorra's tax residency process, but the exact requirements depend on your profile and the type of residency you're applying for. We'll walk you through the options that apply to your situation.
